List of challenge KPIs and how the project addressed them
Selection of Python Multilingual Library
To support multiple languages and scale as needed, we have chosen i18nice, a derived library of the standard i18n that offers scalable multilingual support.
Code Design Improvement
We reviewed the code design and transitioned the configuration files from .env to .ini format, enhancing maintainability for users.

—-----
List of project KPIs and how the project addressed them
Multilingual Support
Now supports 8 languages, allowing flexible changes via configuration files: Japanese, English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, Korean, Thai, and Vietnamese.
Annual Maintenance
Over the course of the year, we performed 8 version updates to accommodate changes in cardano-cli/node and blocklog.
